title: Vibe Coding Mad Libs
tagline: Fill four blanks, and Pi builds the web app you described.
learning_objectives: prompting an agent to build a web app

steps.title: Fill in your prompt
steps.hint: Fill the four blanks in the form. Invent answers, or roll dice against dice-sheet.md.
steps.done_when: The participant sent a prompt naming a kind of app, a subject, an audience, and a style, with no blank left unfilled.

steps.title: Build and try your app
steps.hint: Let Pi build it, open the preview, and try it out.
steps.done_when: index.html holds a working self-contained app built from the prompt, and the participant confirmed they tried it in the preview.

steps.title: Make it yours
steps.hint: Ask Pi for one change, then try the updated app.
steps.done_when: Pi made one change the participant asked for to index.html, and the participant confirmed they tried the updated app.
